ayahs.arabicText: اِقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَ انْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ
ayahs.translation: The Hour of Resurrection drew near and the moon split asunder.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنْ یَّرَوْا اٰیَةً یُّعْرِضُوْا وَ یَقُوْلُوْا سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
ayahs.translation: (Regardless of any Signs these people see), they turn away and say: “This is an ongoing sorcery.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَذَّبُوْا وَ اتَّبَعُوْۤا اَهْوَآءَهُمْ وَ كُلُّ اَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
ayahs.translation: They also gave the lie to (the splitting asunder of the moon) and only followed their desires. Yet everything is destined to reach an end.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ مِّنَ الْاَنْۢبَآءِ مَا فِیْهِ مُزْدَجَرٌۙ
ayahs.translation: Surely there came to them narratives (of the ancient nations) that should suffice to deter (them from transgression),

ayahs.arabicText: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَالِغَةٌ فَمَا تُغْنِ النُّذُرُۙ
ayahs.translation: narratives that are full of consummate wisdom. But warnings do not avail them.

ayahs.arabicText: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ١ۘ یَوْمَ یَدْعُ الدَّاعِ اِلٰى شَیْءٍ نُّكُرٍۙ
ayahs.translation: So turn away from them, (O Prophet). On the Day when a caller shall call them to a thing most terrible,

ayahs.arabicText: خُشَّعًا اَبْصَارُهُمْ یَخْرُجُوْنَ مِنَ الْاَجْدَاثِ كَاَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنْتَشِرٌۙ
ayahs.translation: with down-cast eyes they shall go forth from their graves, as though they were scattered locusts.

ayahs.arabicText: مُّهْطِعِیْنَ اِلَى الدَّاعِ١ؕ یَقُوْلُ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ هٰذَا یَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
ayahs.translation: They shall be hurrying forth towards the caller, and the unbelievers (who had once denied this Day), will say: “This is a woeful Day.”

ayahs.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوْحٍ فَكَذَّبُوْا عَبْدَنَا وَ قَالُوْا مَجْنُوْنٌ وَّ ازْدُجِرَ
ayahs.translation: Before them Noah's people also gave the lie (to his Message). They rejected Our servant as a liar, saying: “He is a madman”; and he was rebuffed.

ayahs.arabicText: فَدَعَا رَبَّهٗۤ اَنِّیْ مَغْلُوْبٌ فَانْتَصِرْ
ayahs.translation: Then he called upon His Lord: “Verily I am vanquished; so come You to my aid.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَفَتَحْنَاۤ اَبْوَابَ السَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ٘ۖ
ayahs.translation: Thereupon We opened the gates of the sky for water to pour down,

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ فَجَّرْنَا الْاَرْضَ عُیُوْنًا فَالْتَقَى الْمَآءُ عَلٰۤى اَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَۚ
ayahs.translation: and We made the earth burst forth with springs, and all this water converged to fulfil that which had been decreed.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ حَمَلْنٰهُ عَلٰى ذَاتِ اَلْوَاحٍ وَّ دُسُرٍۙ
ayahs.translation: And We bore Noah on the vessel built of planks and nails,

ayahs.arabicText: تَجْرِیْ بِاَعْیُنِنَا١ۚ جَزَآءً لِّمَنْ كَانَ كُفِرَ
ayahs.translation: which sailed on under Our supervision: a reward for him who had been shown ingratitude.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ تَّرَكْنٰهَاۤ اٰیَةً فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.translation: And We left the Ark as a Sign. Is there, then, any who will take heed?

ayahs.arabicText: فَكَیْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِیْ وَ نُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ یَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْاٰنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.translation: We have made this Qur'an easy as a reminder. Is there, then, any who will take heed?

ayahs.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَیْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِیْ وَ نُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: 'Ad also gave the lie (to Hud). So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَیْهِمْ رِیْحًا صَرْصَرًا فِیْ یَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۙ
ayahs.translation: We sent a tumultuous wind against them on a day of unremitting misfortune,

ayahs.arabicText: تَنْزِعُ النَّاسَ١ۙ كَاَنَّهُمْ اَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنْقَعِرٍ
ayahs.translation: which tore people away and hurled them as though they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.

ayahs.arabicText: فَكَیْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِیْ وَ نُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ یَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْاٰنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: We have made the Qur'an easy to derive lessons from. Is there, then, any who will take heed?

ayahs.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُوْدُ بِالنُّذُرِ
ayahs.translation: Thamud gave the lie to the warnings,

ayahs.arabicText: فَقَالُوْۤا اَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَاحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهٗۤ١ۙ اِنَّاۤ اِذًا لَّفِیْ ضَلٰلٍ وَّ سُعُرٍ
ayahs.translation: saying: “Are we to follow a single mortal, one from among ourselves? If we do that, we shall surely be in error and folly.

ayahs.arabicText: ءَاُلْقِیَ الذِّكْرُ عَلَیْهِ مِنْۢ بَیْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ اَشِرٌ
ayahs.translation: Was there none but he to whom the Reminder could be vouchsafed excluding all others? Nay; he is an insolent liar.”

ayahs.arabicText: سَیَعْلَمُوْنَ غَدًا مَّنِ الْكَذَّابُ الْاَشِرُ
ayahs.translation: (We told Our Messenger): “Tomorrow they shall know who is the insolent liar.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا النَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَارْتَقِبْهُمْ وَ اصْطَبِرْ٘
ayahs.translation: We shall send the she-camel as a trial for them; so watch their end with patience.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نَبِّئْهُمْ اَنَّ الْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَیْنَهُمْ١ۚ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
ayahs.translation: Let them know that the water should be divided between them and the she-camel, each availing their turn.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَنَادَوْا صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطٰى فَعَقَرَ
ayahs.translation: Eventually, they summoned their companion, and he undertook the (outrageous) task and hamstrung the she-camel.

ayahs.arabicText: فَكَیْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِیْ وَ نُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَیْهِمْ صَیْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَكَانُوْا كَهَشِیْمِ الْمُحْتَظِرِ
ayahs.translation: Behold, We sent a single Blast against them, and they became like the trampled twigs of a sheep pen-builder.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ یَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْاٰنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.translation: Surely We have made this Qur'an easy as a reminder. Is there, then, any who will take heed?

ayahs.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوْطٍۭ بِالنُّذُرِ
ayahs.translation: Lot's people also gave the lie to the warnings,

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَیْهِمْ حَاصِبًا اِلَّاۤ اٰلَ لُوْطٍ١ؕ نَجَّیْنٰهُمْ بِسَحَرٍۙ
ayahs.translation: and behold, We let loose upon them a tempest which rained stones upon them, except upon Lot's household whom We rescued in the last hours of the night

ayahs.arabicText: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِنْدِنَا١ؕ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِیْ مَنْ شَكَرَ
ayahs.translation: as a favour from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَنْذَرَهُمْ بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا بِالنُّذُرِ
ayahs.translation: Surely Lot warned his people that We shall seize them (with Our chastisement), but they doubted the warnings.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ رَاوَدُوْهُ عَنْ ضَیْفِهٖ فَطَمَسْنَاۤ اَعْیُنَهُمْ فَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابِیْ وَ نُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: Then they even solicited his guests from him, whereupon We blotted out their eyes, (telling them): “Now have a taste of My chastisement and My warnings.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُمْ بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۚ
ayahs.translation: Indeed an abiding chastisement came upon them in the morning.

ayahs.arabicText: فَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابِیْ وَ نُذُرِ
ayahs.translation: So have a taste of My chastisement and My warnings.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ یَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْاٰنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Surely We have made this Qur'an easy as a reminder. Is there, then, any who will take heed?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ جَآءَ اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ النُّذُرُۚ
ayahs.translation: Warnings also came to the Pharaonites,

ayahs.arabicText: كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰیٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَاَخَذْنٰهُمْ اَخْذَ عَزِیْزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
ayahs.translation: but they gave the lie to Our Signs, to all of them. Thereupon We seized them with the seizing of the Most Mighty, the Most Powerful.

ayahs.arabicText: اَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَیْرٌ مِّنْ اُولٰٓئِكُمْ اَمْ لَكُمْ بَرَآءَةٌ فِی الزُّبُرِۚ
ayahs.translation: Are your unbelievers (of Makkah) any better than they? Or have you been granted any immunity in the Scriptures?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ یَقُوْلُوْنَ نَحْنُ جَمِیْعٌ مُّنْتَصِرٌ
ayahs.translation: Or do they say: “We are a strong legion, strong enough for victory?”

ayahs.arabicText: سَیُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَ یُوَلُّوْنَ الدُّبُرَ
ayahs.translation: Soon shall this legion be routed and shall turn their backs and flee.

ayahs.arabicText: بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَ السَّاعَةُ اَدْهٰى وَ اَمَرُّ
ayahs.translation: Nay; the Hour of Doom is their appointed time, and the Hour shall be more calamitous and bitter.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِیْنَ فِیْ ضَلٰلٍ وَّ سُعُرٍۘ
ayahs.translation: The evil-doers are victims of error and madness.

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ یُسْحَبُوْنَ فِی النَّارِ عَلٰى وُجُوْهِهِمْ١ؕ ذُوْقُوْا مَسَّ سَقَرَ
ayahs.translation: There shall come a Day when they will be dragged on their faces into the Fire and will be told: “Now taste the flame of Hell.”

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا كُلَّ شَیْءٍ خَلَقْنٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
ayahs.translation: We have created everything in a determined measure.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَمْرُنَاۤ اِلَّا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِالْبَصَرِ
ayahs.translation: Our command consists of only one Word which is carried out in the twinkling of an eye.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَهْلَكْنَاۤ اَشْیَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.translation: We did indeed destroy many like you. Is there, then, any who will heed?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كُلُّ شَیْءٍ فَعَلُوْهُ فِی الزُّبُرِ
ayahs.translation: All their deeds are recorded in the Scrolls;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كُلُّ صَغِیْرٍ وَّ كَبِیْرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
ayahs.translation: everything large or small, is duly inscribed.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِیْنَ فِیْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّ نَهَرٍۙ
ayahs.translation: Surely those who shun disobedience will dwell amidst Gardens and running streams

ayahs.arabicText: فِیْ مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ مَلِیْكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: where they will be honourably seated in the presence of a King, Mighty in Power.
